display_name: wakewordlab + Silero VAD + speaker verifier (hey jarvis)
description: The full listener stack for 'hey jarvis' on wakewordlab: an external Silero pre-wake VAD gate (the plugin's own built-in VAD is disabled to avoid double-gating), then the wakewordlab detector, then a speaker-verification confirm.
notes: Combo fighter: pre-wake VAD + wake-word engine + verifier. The plugin's own config.hotwords.hey_jarvis.vad is set to false and an external listener.VAD stage is used instead, so this gate is the same mechanism as the openWakeWord -silero combo fighters (vs. the bare wakewordlab-hey-jarvis fighter, which uses the plugin's built-in VAD gate).
